description: She wears an opaque purple textured gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and a floor-length skirt opening onto a cream underdress. Broad gold woven floral borders edge the neckline, waist, central panels, cuffs and hem. Small jeweled shoulder brooches and a jeweled waist clasp decorate the garment. A cream wrap with purple-and-gold borders drapes over her forearms. Drop earrings and a dark-stone ring are visible. Gold-toned patterned soft shoes show beneath the lower skirt.
